Card Q&A.q: Only the top card of my opponent's security card is face up. If this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates, what security card is flipped to face up?

Card Q&A.a: They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

Card Q&A.a: The check is performed with the card left revealed. Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.
Card Q&A.q: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check with that card placed face-up?

Card Q&A.a: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?

Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

If I attack with this card, an opponent's face-up security card is checked for the security check, then this card's [Your Turn] effect activates and I place the top card of this Digimon at the bottom of the security stack, does the [End of Attack] effect on the Digimon under this card trigger?

An opponent's Digimon attacks a player by an effect at the end of their turn. What happens if this card's {Security} [End of Opponent's Turn] effect then plays this card, my security stack is reduced to 0 cards, and the attack against the player is successful?

Card Q&A.a:
This card stacked on top is removed, causing this Digimon to become a Tamer, therefore the attacking Digimon is considered to be removed.
